property_summary: The transfer function returns true when it does not revert.
The transfer function returns the same boolean as the underlying token transfer outcome (success) for each recipient.
If a transfer does not revert, it returns true.
The transfer function returns true after a successful call to all recipients.
The transfer function returns true when all individual token transfers succeed.
All calls to transferFrom must succeed or the entire transaction reverts.

After calling transfer, the function returns true if and only if all individual transferFrom calls succeeded; otherwise it reverts (reference) vs. returns false (mutant), so the rule is that the reference always ends with a successful (non-reverting) call and returns true, while the mutant can return false without reverting.
For any call to transfer, the reference always reverts if any inner call fails and never returns false.
The reference function transfer always returns true if it does not revert, meaning it never returns false.
The transfer function of the reference contract always returns true when it does not revert.
